purpose: Test whether the score-tail audit and audit-controlled inference story remains meaningful for a frozen public visual-language neural scorer, without claiming VLA-scale policy validation or robot SOTA.

primary_dataset.family: Gymnasium Robotics Fetch RGB rollout pools
primary_dataset.candidate_source: existing benchmark rollout generator and simulator adapter
primary_dataset.image_source: rendered final state for each candidate rollout
primary_dataset.real_utility: heldout simulator utility already used by the score-tail audit
primary_dataset.gpu_inputs: RGB final-outcome frames plus frozen task text prompts

frozen_model.optional_calibrator: ridge regression on frozen image embeddings only, labeled as a lightweight calibrator rather than VLA or policy training

scorers.name: clip_task_text
scorers.definition: CLIP image-text similarity between final-outcome frame and the task prompt

scorers.name: clip_mismatch_text
scorers.definition: negative control using a prompt from a different Fetch task

scorers.name: clip_ridge
scorers.definition: tiny ridge utility predictor trained on frozen final-frame CLIP embeddings only

scorers.name: clip_ridge_shuffled
scorers.definition: negative control ridge model trained after permuting training utilities

scorers.name: low_energy
scorers.definition: non-neural heuristic baseline using negative action energy

scorers.name: oracle_real_utility
scorers.definition: diagnostic upper bound using true rollout utility

pre_gpu_gates: CPU smoke run completes with mock or tiny CLIP model
output CSV/JSON schemas are validated by tests
Kaggle job package is generated without secrets in the repository
protocol file is committed or at least staged before GPU execution

include_in_main_if: the run completes without manual notebook intervention
at least one frozen neural scorer or frozen-embedding calibrator has a positive learned-vs-random lower confidence bound, or the audit/negative-control result is clearly diagnostic
mismatched or shuffled control is reported
all text preserves no-real-robot, no-VLA-scale-SOTA, and no-policy-training boundaries
main_paper_inclusion_gate.otherwise: archive as an appendix/artifact or omit from the main paper

nonclaims: not GPU training of a robot policy
not evidence that blind high-N sampling always helps
